people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahweh of Armies.
translations.bsb: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of Hosts.
translations.kjv: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.
translations.asv: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt-offering and the peace-offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Jehovah of hosts.
